# Funnel Leak Finder

`funnel-leak-finder` · v1.1.0 · Diagnose · Analytics & Experimentation
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/funnel-leak-finder/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Which funnel stage cost us the most wins, purchases or paid subscribers this period, against last period or our own targets, and is that change real or noise?

**Inputs:** This period's funnel counts for one of three funnels - B2B (sessions, leads, MQLs, SQLs, opportunities, wins), ecommerce (sessions, product page views if you have them, add to cart, checkout, purchases) or subscription app (installs, sign-ups, activated, started trial if you have it, paid); at least 3 consecutive stages - and a baseline, which is last period's counts or your target rate per stage, with where the targets come from; optionally revenue per win, purchase or paid subscriber, and your margin on it

**Output:** Each stage's rate against its baseline in points and relative terms, the wins, purchases or paid subscribers (and revenue and profit) each shortfall cost, the stages ranked, the leak named, a noise check per stage, and a plain statement when no baseline was given

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill funnel-leak-finder`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://mcp.aajconsult.com/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/funnel-leak-finder/resources/funnel-leak.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/funnel-leak-finder/resources/funnel-leak.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- No baseline, no leak: without last period's counts or your own target rates the engine shows the stage rates and names nothing, because raw drop-off cannot say where wins were lost.
- Each stage's wins lost holds the other stages at this period's rates, so the figures do not add up to the total change in wins.
- Counts in one period are not one cohort: wins this quarter partly come from opportunities created earlier, and people who installed an app late in the period have had less time to pay. With a long cycle, compare longer or lagged periods.
- The noise check treats each count as an independent trial. Sessions are not people, so for steps that start from sessions it overstates certainty. The 95% level and the 5-count minimum are AAJ's choices.

**Review before acting:** The people who own the funnel confirm that the stage definitions (an MQL, SQL and opportunity; or an add to cart, a checkout and an activated user) were the same in both periods, that ecommerce counts are sessions and not events, and that any target rates come from a plan or source they can name.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/funnel-leak-finder](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/funnel-leak-finder)
